results.id: LOGIC detailed node 'האם תאריך הערך מאוחר מתאריך המסירה (ביום קלנדרי אחד לפחות)?' (IsDeliveryDelay)
results.detail: Re-checked after fix: node now asks whether at least one whole day elapsed between delivery date and value date; tech quotes DateAndTime.DateDiff(DateInterval.Day, deliveryDate, valuedate) > 0, computed only when both dates are non-NULL, on raw DB values, and labels the elapsed-whole-days semantics as general .NET knowledge, not package evidence. Matches DTSX 391 (null guards, raw values) and 448-454 (IsDeliveryDelay). detail_he item 5 and the decision meaning_he use the same wording. Previous issue (unproven calendar-day wording) resolved.

Write condition (SQL population, IsFull/transferCount>0 vs Not full/Sums Are Equal, unconnected 'Has not thansactions' and 'Sums Are Not Equal') verified against paths. NULL) gets several Update requests, last one wins (order undefined).

results.id: LOGIC finding#1 (expected amount multiplied by number of ft rows in the group)
results.detail: GROUP BY includes ac.gen_accountcoursesId, ft.gen_valuedate, ft.gen_appendixghissuingdate; within a group there is one ac row joined to N ft rows (ftt joined on its PK), so sum(ISNULL(ac.gen_transactionamount,0)) = N x amount while actual = sum of N ft amounts; equality <=> average of ft amounts = course amount. Business intent unknown - correctly stated.

results.id: LOGIC finding#2 (not-full request closed if one group matches)
results.detail: Compare sums is evaluated per SQL group; passing rows are unioned and aggregated by care id, so one matching group suffices to close the request.

results.id: LOGIC finding#3 (NULL Gen_isfulltransfer fails the data flow)
results.detail: IsFull output errorRowDisposition=FailComponent; expression 'Gen_isfulltransfer ==  TRUE'; a NULL condition result in a Conditional Split is an evaluation error handled by the disposition (SSIS behaviour). Whether NULLs occur is correctly left conditional.

results.id: LOGIC finding#4 (no filter on request type)
results.detail: WHERE has only ftt.gen_transgrouptype = 2, ft.Gen_EntryDate > Tout.CreatedOn, Tout.Gen_currentstate = 1; no type/category column of Gen_customercare is filtered.

ExcecuteBulk() is called inside the per-row try (Count == 1000); an exception skips myEntities.Clear(), current row goes to CastingError, Count never equals 1000 again; final flush in Input0_ProcessInput is outside any try so an exception there fails the component. Caveat: 'sent in one request' means one ExecuteMultipleExtension call; whether the external CRM.Proxy splits it is external_unknown.

results.id: LOGIC finding#6 (several appendix dates -> several updates of the same care)
results.detail: Aggregate groups by Gen_customercareId, Gen_deliverydate, gen_appendixghissuingdate (all AggregationType 0); each output row becomes a separate Update; order not determined by the package.

results.detail: WarningTitle literal at DTSX 2231, RecordKey "" at DTSX 2219; ErrorBuffer.Description = resultItem.Fault.Message only.
count(ft.Gen_ftCurrentYearId) over an inner join; hedged on the id being non-NULL.

AggregationType 6 on gen_valuedate; Minimum per the SSIS enum (GroupBy 0, Count 1, CountAll 2, CountDistinct 3, Sum 4, Avg 5, Min 6, Max 7); consistent with other packages (2 on a column named 'Count all', 4 on gen_accountbalance) and the code comment 'min entry date'. Correctly labelled as from Microsoft documentation, not from the package.
